objectives.description: Port researched/planned/implemented/partial-failed-blocked/Tier-C case ladder with completion-claim gate
Transition via skill_postflight_update with monotonic-max clamp threaded from --force-invoked
Completion propagation via skill_orchestrate_propagate_completion, reusing recover_json when present
Artifact-round advance: unconditional on researched, additionally on forced planned/implemented
Excursion advisory (modified_files vs file_scope), detection only
objectives.note: Found and fixed a real jq bug during hand-testing: `$p | startswith(.)` rebinds `.` to `$p` itself for the argument's own evaluation, making the check vacuously true. Fixed via `any($fs[]; . as $f | $p == $f or ($p | startswith($f)))`.

objectives.description: Off-schema dispatch_status: banner, OFF_SCHEMA_STATUS record, no transition
objectives.note: offschema_dispatch_status exposed in the (still-provisional) output JSON; final verdict mapping is Phase 5's own task per the plan's phase split.

approaches_tried.description: Initial excursion-advisory jq predicate: any($fs[]; $p == . or ($p | startswith(.)))
approaches_tried.reason: jq evaluates a builtin's argument against the input just piped into it, so `$p | startswith(.)` degenerates to `startswith($p)` (always true) rather than comparing against the any() generator's current value. Hand-testing against a real excursion fixture caught this before Phase 6's fixture suite would have.
